spec.description: Full monitoring for Technitium DNS - single servers or clusters. Realtime queries/sec, cache hit %, block %, and SERVFAILs from lifetime counters; windowed stats (LastHour/LastDay/...) with Pi-hole-style top clients, domains, and blocked domains; zone and DHCP inventory; DNS resolution health and server version. Powered by the technitium-dns-prometheus-exporter (Python), with ready-made Prometheus alerting rules in the repo.

spec.title: Zones / cache / blocklists
spec.description: Zones, cache entries, and blocklist zones over time (good for spotting sync/import issues).

spec.title: API Status
spec.description: Technitium API health from exporter (1 = up, 0 = down). If this is down, other Technitium metrics may be stale or missing.

spec.title: Cache Ratio (stats window)
spec.description: Share of cached answers inside the current Technitium stats window. Formula: cached / all (denominator includes authoritative, blocked, and dropped queries).

spec.title: Query types (A / AAAA / HTTPS / …)
spec.description: Breakdown of DNS query types (A, AAAA, HTTPS, PTR, etc.) over time.

spec.title: Protocols
spec.description: Breakdown of protocol usage for DNS queries (UDP / TCP / DoH / DoT etc depending on Technitium config).

spec.title: Total Queries (stats window)
spec.description: Total DNS queries in the selected Technitium stats window (e.g. LastHour).

spec.title: Zone Health
spec.description: List of zones from Technitium with status and type. Uses Info metric labels from technitium_zone_info.

spec.title: DHCP Scopes (Active Leases)
spec.description: Active DHCP leases per scope, split by lease type (Dynamic / Reserved / etc) from Technitium DHCP API.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio (trend)
spec.description: Cache hit ratio over time from response types. Formula: Cached / (Cached + Recursive). Measures cache effectiveness for resolver-dependent queries only — authoritative, blocked, and dropped are excluded. Differs from the 'Cache Ratio' gauge which uses cached / all queries.

spec.title: Total Managed Zones
spec.description: Total number of zones managed by Technitium (from dashboard stats).

spec.title: Zones in Allow List
spec.description: Number of zones explicitly in allow-list (from dashboard stats).

spec.title: Allowed Zones
spec.description: Number of zones explicitly allowed (whitelisted).

spec.title: Manually Blocked Zones
spec.description: Number of zones manually marked as blocked (distinct from imported blocklist zones).

spec.title: Zones in Block List
spec.description: Number of zones from imported blocklists (distinct from manually blocked zones).

spec.title: % Blocked (stats window)
spec.description: Share of blocked queries inside the current Technitium stats window (blocked / all).

spec.title: Clients Over Time
spec.description: Number of unique clients seen per scrape over time (based on stats window snapshot).

spec.title: Top Clients (Trend)
spec.description: Top clients over time (hits per client from stats window snapshot). Use for spotting noisy clients.

spec.title: Unique Clients (stats window)
spec.description: Number of unique DNS clients seen in the current Technitium stats window.

spec.title: Server Uptime
spec.description: DNS server uptime since last restart (lifetime counter).

spec.title: Queries / sec
spec.description: Current queries per second rate (averaged over 1 min, lifetime counters).

spec.title: Cache Hit % (realtime)
spec.description: Cache hit ratio from realtime lifetime counters (cached / all avg over 1 min).

spec.title: Block % (realtime)
spec.description: Blocked ratio from realtime lifetime counters (blocked / all avg over 1 min).

spec.title: Lifetime Clients
spec.description: Total unique clients seen since server start (lifetime counter).

spec.title: QPS by Category (realtime)
spec.description: Per-second rate by query result category (averaged over 1 min). Shows real throughput.

spec.title: Servfail Errors
spec.description: Rate of server failures (SERVFAIL) from realtime lifetime counters.

spec.title: Stats Window
spec.description: Currently configured stats window range from the exporter (e.g. LastHour, LastDay).

spec.title: DNS Health
spec.description: DNS resolution health via /api/dnsClient/healthCheck (1 = server resolves queries). Stronger signal than API Status: a server with a dead port 53 still shows API Up. Requires Technitium >= 15.3 and exporter >= 2.2.0; shows n/a on older versions.

spec.title: Queries by Category (Trend)
spec.description: Breakdown of queries in the current stats window by category (no_error, nxdomain, blocked, etc.), plotted over time via Prometheus scraping.

spec.title: Version
spec.description: Technitium DNS server version (the controller's, in cluster mode). From /api/user/session/get; requires exporter >= 2.2.0.

spec.title: Top Queried Domains
spec.description: Most-queried domains in the current stats window (hits per domain).

spec.title: Top Blocked Domains
spec.description: Most-blocked domains in the selected stats window (hits per blocked domain).

spec.title: Top Clients
spec.description: Tabular view of top clients with total hits in the current stats window snapshot.

spec.title: Technitium DNS Exporter
